name: HEXACO Personality Inventory
description: Measures six personality dimensions: Honesty-Humility, Emotionality, eXtraversion, Agreeableness, Conscientiousness, and Openness. Adds Honesty-Humility as a sixth factor beyond Big Five.
reputation: Growing empirical support; free versions available; captures dark-triad-adjacent traits via Honesty-Humility.
notes: Less commercially adopted than Big Five; fewer norms across cultures.
